messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: updateTextArea and updateFileInput possible?
parts:
I just found out about the updateTextInput etc. set of functions. Super useful! Thanks. There are two more that would be really useful, at least for me. updateTextArea and updateFileInput.

I use a text area so you can copy-and-paste data from Excel. The text is processed by read.table and then stored in a reactive value. I recently added a feature to delete data stored in the app. However, as long as the textArea contains the pasted data this is not possible. 

The same applies to the fileUpload object (as far as I can tell). Once a file is uploaded in the app it is stored as a reactive value but it can only be deleted from memory after (1) another file is uploaded or (2) you refresh the webpage.

Is this possible?

Server version at: vnijs.rady.ucsd.edu

See Data, Manage tab

Code: https://github.com/mostly-harmless/radyant

messages.subject: Re: updateTextArea and updateFileInput possible?
parts:
Seems you can use updateTextInput for a textarea as well if you add a 'label':

updateTextInput(session = session, inputId = "xls_paste", label = "", '')

Any ideas on how to achieve the equivalent of updateFileInput?
